batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b RA Jadeja

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b R Rampaul

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: st YV Takawale b Yuvraj Singh

balls.text: the extra ball goes for only one, Rana tries another heave to another length delivery, but he cannot connect
Starc has a slog to a pitched up delivery, thick inside edge runs through square leg
Nehra gets away with a length ball, Rana tries to slog it over the leg side with the incoming angle but misses
a high full toss, Starc swings hard, and the ball rolls down to long off
Nehra's response is one more yorker, and Kohli cannot prevent it from hitting the stumps even as he brings his bat down, it brushes the bat, then onto pad and onward to the stumps
a length ball, Kohli takes a couple of steps out and slogs it 93 metres and over the deep midwicket boundary
hurls a full toss down the leg side, umpire calls it a wide,  Kohli signals it has brushed him, but the decision has been made
a length ball close to off, he hits it towards sweeper cover, they push for the second and a wide throw helps them
just misses the yorker, Kohli cracks it to long off
another slower length ball, this time he taps it to point and gets the captain back on strike
slower one from back of the hand, it moves away outside off past Rana's swipe
full, wide and angled further away, Kohli pushes it to extra cover
Kohli reaches forward to force it over midwicket, he hasn't hit it too well, but done enough to clear Jadeja's jump at deep midwicket
keeps the strike with a push to extra cover off the length ball
a length ball in to off and middle, whipped through square leg
Nehra gets the yorker in, and takes out the middle stump, after AB slogs and misses
a length ball slanted in towards off, AB gets down on his knee and slogs high over midwicket
hammers a pitched up ball straight to long off
starts the over with a full toss, Kohli moves forward and easily swats it between deep midwicket and long on
a low full toss, AB reaches forward, brings out the reverse sweep and connects crisply, into the third man boundary
goes deep in the crease this time and pulls with the turn to the deep square leg boundary to bring up his fifty
sees him advancing out again, and bowls it full into the pad, Kohli kicks it away
AB jumps out now, Ashwin gets it to bounce as he shortens the length, he is hit on the pad and the ball pops up on the leg side
comes down the track and turns a length ball to deep midwicket
hit to long on for one
now he fires it at 101.3 kph down the leg side
bowled a tad slower, and it spins past the outside edge as Kohli tries to drive it
backs away outside leg, Jadeja follows him, AB sweeps it behind square, but there is a deep fielder there
hit to sweeper cover for a single
tosses it up wider and slower outside off, Kohli drives hard but cannot beat the sweeper
hurled fast and flat and down the leg side
superb stop from David Hussey, Kohli had slogged it hard, and it was bouncing over him as he ran to his left from deep midwicket, but he jumped and slapped the ball back in with his left hand
lunges forward and scoops it in the air past the non-striker to long on
flat length ball not rising much, AB whips it from outside off to long on
hits it to the left of long off for a single
works it through midwicket and immediately shouts 'two', de Villiers has to rush back, direct hit would have been interesting
dancing down yet again, and swatting it 87 metres into the crowd over the long off boundary
skips out of the crease, Badree bowls it full into the legs, Kohli works it wide of deep midwicket
gone, Jadeja strikes first over, Yuvraj slog-sweeps a length ball from outside off, it bounces  a touch more than he would have liked and he picks out Raina at deep midwicket
charges out, Jadeja hurls it in flat and quick, Kohli swipes, mishits it through midwicket
full around off, drilled straight down the ground to long off
leaves the crease and pushes for one to long on
shortish, Yuvraj rocks back and pulls, but long on reaches it to his left
angles it in full, Kohli comes forward and pushes it past the bowler to long on
comes forward to defend solidly to the off side
that'll go too, quick and flat outside off, Yuvraj crouches, delays his shot a tad, and late-cuts behind backward point
Yuvraj loses his balance and falls as he lunges forward for the slog-sweep, but despite that he's placed it wide of the deep fielder and into the deep midwicket rope
and again, when Kohli steps out, Raina drags the length back, Kohli turns it through midwicket
quick and flat just outside off, punched to extra cover
pushed to midwicket
leaves the crease, takes it on the full, works it straight to square leg
leans forward to a length offbreak, taps it to the leg side
sees it spinning away sharply, stops his forward lunge, and guides it to point
backs away to a good length offbreak and dabs it behind point
Kohli stays back this time, Ashwin bowls it shortish, and Kohli pulls it powerfully with the turn over deep midwicket
Kohli is stepping out frequently but he is not getting the length to get underneath, Ashwin shortens it and Kohli works it square, past the dive from the fielder in the circle
skips out once more, but Raina drags the length back, Kohli can only knock it along the ground to long on
bends forward, opens the face and guides it to point for one
leans forward and works it to long on with the spin
sees him coming down, shortens the length, Kohli taps it to midwicket
nudged fine off the pads, Mohit Sharma has had plenty of running to do in the deep, he puts in another long run and saves the four with a dive, gets up and limps back to his position
makes room and hits to sweeper cover
lets this offbreak go as it travels down the leg side, not given a wide, umpire Llong signals it brushed Kohli's pad
reaches forward to push solidly to extra cover
Kohli out of the crease now, hitting with the spin, and swatting it over deep midwicket
swept hard to fine leg
Yuvraj skips out, he is not quite to the pitch, but chips it cleanly over the bowler, Mohit does well to save the boundary with a dive on the boundary
length ball pushed past a diving Raina to long on
some turn outside off, Yuvraj punches to extra cover off the back foot
makes some room and punches a flat offbreak, midwicket dives but cannot stop it
worked to fine leg off the pad
short, deserves to be put away, Kohli rocks back and pulls hard, finds deep midwicket
whipped past square leg, Jadeja from deep midwicket sprints across to keep them to one
beaten, this seemed to hold the line after it pitched good length close to off, and zipped past Kohli's prod
rises from just short of a length, Kohli adjusts to push it to the off side, extra cover runs across to prevent the single
plenty of width outside off and Yuvraj crashes it square, but Raina throws himself to his left at backward point to save a certain boundary
angled across just outside off, back of a length, whipped to midwicket
Kohli is made to stay in the crease, a 132 kph length ball is guided to third man
leans into the drive on this length ball but cannot beat extra cover
bends forward again to defend an offbreak that bounces a bit more
pitched up and straightening around off stump, he is forward to block
shorter one turning in from outside off, punched to long on
some spin for Raina, which takes the ball down the leg side
back and across to a length offbreak, turns it to square leg now
offbreak on middle, he goes back to turn it to midwicket
pushes forward and gets a thick edge towards the third man boundary before it is pulled back inside
Mohit goes short, at 133.4 kph, and Yuvraj crouches into a pull, there is deep square leg around
tries to drive a length ball around middle and leg, but hits it off the inner half of the bat to midwicket
Zol's had one swing too many, he wanted to slog this length delivery with the incoming angle over midwicket, he missed, and Mohit hit middle stump
short of a length again, angled in towards off, played out to point
tries to pull a short of a length ball but mishits it off the lower part of the bat to mid on
lofts the length delivery high over mid off, clears the man easily but hasn't timed it well enough to reach the rope
worked to square leg, Zol had taken a start and has to hurry back

given by umpire Anil Chaudhary after a long appeal, Takawale pushed forward but played outside the line as it straightened a bit from round the stumps, but it was still angling across, and struck him on the line of off stump, not sure that was going to hit off
lunges forward and bends to sweep but drags it to midwicket
goes back to work it to square leg off the pads
length ball with slight turn into the pad, nudged square
comes forward to turn a full ball on middle and leg to midwicket
slight spin outside off but it is shortish, and Takawale opens up to swat a pull between long on and deep midwicket, there is a dive near the rope from Mohit, in vain
some bounce on the legbreak outside off, dabbed to short third man
pushed to backward point
four more, Takawale sweeps again, goes behind square, but well to the left of short fine leg, superb placement
comes down the track, Badree shortens the length, and Takawale has to push it away
takes it from around off stump and sweeps crisply, into the deep square leg rope
tucked behind square leg for a couple
Zol tees off straight, Nehra bowls it on a length just outside off, Zol lunges forward and picks it high over the boundary
short ball now, 130.5 kph, Takawale gets on his toes, fends it down into the off side
width on this short of a length ball but Jadeja dives full-length to his left at backward point to stop the cut, saved a boundary
sends it in to middle and leg this time, and it is tucked to long leg for a single
good length ball straightening on off, defended
does not let him bowl a maiden, gets down on his knee for the slog-sweep and cracks it to the deep midwicket boundary
again played out quietly off the back foot, this was a legbreak straightening around off
plays it off the back foot, as it pitches good length and carries in towards him
bowls a legbreak on middle, Takawale comes forward and taps it to the leg side
hit on the pad now as he presses forward, but it strikes him outside the line
nice, tosses it up outside off, draws him forward, he pushes for turn, it comes in instead to beat the inside edge
excellent delivery to end an excellent over, and a rather close leave from Zol, this outswinger barely missed the off stump as he raised his bat high

he's been pegging away in that area around off stump throughout the over, and this time he gets one through, pitched up, slanted in, Rossouw has been kept quiet and tries to force it to leg with an angled bat, misses, and his off stump is uprooted
fuller from Nehra on off, Rossouw squeezes it out to extra cover
comes forward and pushes a length ball down to third man
very tight single to get going, Rossouw pushes a similar ball to mid off and sets off, Manhas runs forward but his throw is wide, even as Rossouw dives in desperately
good delivery to start off, pitches it up right on off stump, straightens it too, Rossouw defends
Faf gets to fifty and ends the game with the last skip down the pitch of the evening, and lofts cleanly over long off
leaves the crease and pushes a flat delivery through covers
Dhoni moves to the leg side as he comes out, Jakato drags it short, Dhoni stops and whacks it over long on
tossed up on the pad, Dhoni comes out and sweeps it hard past short fine leg
a full toss pushed through the off side, extra cover dives to his right to stop it
length ball turned from off stump to long on
yorker on the stumps, but Faf has done well to jab it in front of square, and they have sprinted back for two as well
casually swats a drive, extra cover cannot stop it cleanly, and another single is taken
phew, Dhoni is killing it now, long off is not too far as Dhoni drills a length ball to his left, but it is hit so hard he has no chance
drives a pitched up ball to extra cover for a quick single
Yuvraj will not pitch it up to Dhoni now, Dhoni knows that, it arrives short and angling into him, he pulls, and deep square leg's dive is futile
Faf walks out, gets too close to the pitch, hits it into the pitch and it bounces just over Yuvraj
stays back this time to a flat one darted in and pulls to long on
Dhoni does it again, that missed chance is history, he leaves the crease again, reaches the pitch and sends it 95 metres over the straight boundary
Dhoni sticks to his guns, he charges out, and pummels it way over the long on boundary
missed stumping, Yuvraj cannot believe it, Dhoni jumped out and missed a heave to a full delivery just outside off, the ball stayed a tad low and went through the keeper's legs
flighted on the off, driven through to long-off for a single
tossed up on the off, reaches forward and pushes it towards extra cover
smart stuff from Dhoni, tossed up on middle and Dhoni leaned forward to paddle that wide of short fine leg for a much-needed boundary
fullish on leg stump and that's clipped past square leg for a single
flatter on middle and off, nudged towards point, there's a fumble and Dhoni manages to steal a single
shortish on the off, pulled away towards deep midwicket
length ball hurrying in with the angle, he makes room to hit it through midwicket
reaches forward and pushes it down to long off
that stayed a bit low as it was pushed flat and wide outside off, Dhoni is beaten on the cut
leaves the crease, Yuvraj shortens it, Faf punches it down to long on
around the blockhole, forced back to the bowler
jumps out, taps it in front of midwicket and charges down for the single, limps as he slows down after passing the non-striker's crease
lunges forward, squeezes it to the leg side and limps for a single
comes out and hits it hard through extra cover, long off cuts it off, Dhoni seems to be in some trouble, he twisted his left ankle when he turned around after the single
cuts straight to cover
makes room in the crease to a full delivery and pushes it down to long on
punched down to long off for a single
deep midwicket runs in and keeps them to one as Dhoni works a length ball
swats a flat length ball to deep square leg
makes room to a tossed up ball and tries to drive through the off side, but misses it, that was not far from off stump
takes a couple of steps out and turns it through midwicket
Yuvraj posing more problems, Faf leaves the crease, Yuvraj finds some turn, and a thick outside edge goes to point
cuts an 87 kph legbreak to point
Dhoni walks out, and nudges a full delivery on the leg side for a couple
presses forward to a defend a full legbreak
googly, he goes back and punches it past the bowler to long off
appeal for a catch as Faf jumps out, the ball pops up and keeper comes around to take it, replays show it came off the glove on to the pad
walks out and picks up a single through midwicket as Yuvraj slants it in
goes deep in the crease and turns a length ball in front of square leg
comes forward to push to the off side
Yuvraj strikes, Raina skips out to a flighted ball slanted across him, misses it, and the keeper does the rest
full into the pads, worked behind square leg
goes back in the crease to a tossed up ball and runs it to point
walks down the track, and turns a full one on off through midwicket
close call, Faf comes forward to a tossed up ball and pushes to cover, he is a long way down before he turns back, has to dive in, which is what saves him
opens the face and eases it through extra cover against the turn
makes room and guides it superbly to the right of the sweeper, who has to dive to stop it
comes out first ball of the over and lofts over midwicket
flows forward to push a length ball to sweeper cover
Raina gets one away finally, a back of a length ball sitting up, and Raina pulls it in the air, just over Yuvraj's leap at midwicket
pushes off the front foot to extra cover
good length ball angled in, whipped off the pad to deep midwicket
short and wide, Raina beats backward point but there is a sweeper
stays a touch low from a length outside off, guided to covers
short ball punched down to wide long on
Faf leaves the crease as well, and opens the face to push to extra cover
walks down the crease and pushed softly to long on for one
turned from back in the crease to midwicket
legbreak straightening on middle, he goes back to work it to deep midwicket
comes down the track and pushes a legbreak off the pad through midwicket
shot, du Plessis jumps out, and drills the pitched up ball straight past the non-striker and into the boundary
very full outside off, square driven to cover
pitched up and moving in to hit the pad, but that was headed down the leg side
dabs again and beats short third man, but there is a squarer third man too, and he fields
good length ball just outside off, he leans forward to push to mid on
a slower length ball pushed back to the bowler
back of a length around off, guided towards point
a back of a length ball dabbed to third man
clips a length ball from off and middle in front of square leg
Smith is gone after an electric start, he's tried to whip this length ball to the leg side, ends up mishitting it high for Kohli at midwicket to settle under it
a slower ball, Smith still gets it away, he makes room and reaches forward to swat it straight over the bowler, Starc is at long on, he fails to get there
six more, a top edge but anything goes for six here, Faf pulls a short ball, fine leg is up, would have made little difference if he had been on the rope
full and wide outside off, but way too far
length ball into the pad, turned behind square
finally Smith fails to connect, this was back of a length and coming in close to off, Smith tried to force it away
Smith wants to end this early, over extra cover again as he eases forward and lifts this length delivery way over the infield
pummeled down the ground now, Starc pitches it up, and Smith clears front leg to drill it dead straight
gets the same treatment, Smith gets forward to a length ball and lofts over mid off, does not time it but clears the man
waits on this length ball and hits it towards extra cover, there is a throw at the non-striker's end, but it misses
driven down to long off for a single
now du Plessis, he makes room outside leg and drills it through extra cover, long off dives in vain
smoked over the deep extra cover boundary now, Smith hasn't powered this, he's eased into the stroke and timed it all the way
not too short, but sits up and Smith comes across to pull in front of square, deep square leg runs to his left and dives to stop it
even better connection this time, as Faf jumps out again to a length ball and lofts it way over the long off boundary
gives him the charge, picks up the length delivery and smashes it in the air through midwicket
still wider this time, du Plessis tries to reach it but cannot make contact once again
tries to hit this widish short of a length ball outside off, and is beaten
swatted off the pads to long leg

what a shot, this has been drilled straight past the bowler, on the up, this is nowhere near driving length, but Smith has made slight room and crashed it down the ground with a straight followthrough
leaves the crease and pushes to extra cover
cracks it towards deep midwicket again, Starc in business once more as he runs to his left
whipped to midwicket for a single
survives again, looks to lift it straight, just clears mid on this time
rocks back and pulls a short ball, Starc is at deep midwicket, he comes forward and dives, but it bounces just in front
length ball hurrying in with the angle, punched to mid on from the crease
